article_notes: Nothing extracted. 20 dogs with smear-diagnosed acute babesiosis (large Babesia, species not typed; university clinic, Zhytomyr, Ukraine) vs 20 healthy controls. Tables 1-2 compare circulating volume indices, haematocrit, platelets, platelet and erythrocyte spontaneous aggregation and vascular wall wetting index between infected and healthy dogs only (10 parameters, skipped). The remaining results are a treatment trial (Rheosorbylact vs Rheosorbylact + dipyridamole; figures only), i.e. treatment response, not a comparison against severity or outcome. No severity or outcome groups are defined. Read from the English translation (LLM, not reviewed).
